name: Dual Entry Momentum Strategy - Extended Consolidations
description: Two separate entry criteria: extended consolidation breakouts (7+ days) OR pullback entries in 50%+ momentum stocks
entry_rule: close > sma_50 & close > sma_200 & (close / close_126d_ago) > 1.5 & rsi_14 > 40 & volume > vol_20_avg * 1.1 & volume > 1000000 & (adr_20 / close) > 0.035 & ((high <= high_7d & low >= low_7d) | (high <= high_14d & low >= low_14d) | (high <= high_21d & low >= low_21d) | ((close >= sma_10 * 0.98 & close <= sma_10 * 1.02) | (close >= sma_20 * 0.98 & close <= sma_20 * 1.02) | (close >= sma_50 * 0.98 & close <= sma_50 * 1.02)))
entry_rule_long: close > sma_50 & close > sma_200 & (close / close_126d_ago) > 1.5 & rsi_14 > 40 & volume > vol_20_avg * 1.1 & volume > 1000000 & (adr_20 / close) > 0.035 & ((high <= high_7d & low >= low_7d) | (high <= high_14d & low >= low_14d) | (high <= high_21d & low >= low_21d) | ((close >= sma_10 * 0.98 & close <= sma_10 * 1.02) | (close >= sma_20 * 0.98 & close <= sma_20 * 1.02) | (close >= sma_50 * 0.98 & close <= sma_50 * 1.02)))
exit_rule: ((abs(sma_10 - sma_20) / sma_20) > 0.05 & close < sma_10) | ((abs(sma_10 - sma_20) / sma_20) <= 0.05 & close < sma_20)
